점을 많이 선택하면 ‘몸 전체 진입’에 가까워져 경계 오판은 줄지만 진입: Selecting more points approximates whole-body entry and reduces boundary errors, but can delay entry detection and reduce valid frames. A single point is more sensitive but more susceptible to boundary jitter.

높이면 경계에서 잠깐 걸친 움직임과 좌표 튐을 제거하지만 빠른 실제 진입: Higher values remove brief boundary crossings and coordinate jumps but may miss genuine fast entries. Lower values are more sensitive but can inflate entry counts near a boundary.

Center는 A/B/C 진입 횟수와 교대 순서에 포함되지 않으며 Cen: Center is excluded from A/B/C entry counts and alternation sequences. Its dwell time is summed separately.
같은 Arm에 머무는 동안 신뢰도 저하·가림으로 좌표가 잠깐 사라져도 하: The maximum gap that can bridge a brief loss of coordinates due to low confidence or occlusion while remaining in the same arm.

서로 다른 Arm 사이를 연결하지 않으며 최소 팔 체류시간을 대신하지 않: This does not connect different arms or replace the minimum arm dwell requirement.
